Initial release of smyx-fish-fry-growth-measurement-analysis:

- AI-based measurement of fish fry length from images with a known-size reference object (ruler, coin, calibration board).
- Automatic calculation and tracking of individual fry growth rates over time, with growth curve plotting.
- Supports anomaly detection and multi-level alerts (e.g. stunted growth), including actionable suggestions.
- Designed for aquaculture, ornamental fish breeding, and laboratory environments.
- Integrates with smart fry tanks and management apps; generates structured growth reports and statistical insights.
- Strict operational protocols for open-id authorization, calibration accuracy, and historical report retrieval.
